deployed_code Docker Sandboxes lab

Start here

Run GitHub Copilot in Docker Sandboxes on DevBoard, a small FastAPI and Next.js app: lock its network down, read and build kits, keep your credentials out of its reach, run agents in parallel, give them tools, and move them to the cloud. Then pick your lab, at the bottom of this page.

Pick your lab

  • terminal Hands-on lab The real thing: run every command in a terminal on your own machine, with sbx, a Docker account and GitHub Copilot. The instructions are here; the sandboxes run on your laptop. sbx CLI GitHub Copilot 13 modules ~100 min optional cloud module arrow_forward
  • science Simulated lab The same lab, fully simulated in your browser: the same modules and commands, with four terminals and scripted outputs. Nothing to install, no account needed. in your browser no install milestones ~60 min arrow_forward

How the options differ

Hands-on lab Simulated lab
You need The git, gh and sbx CLIs, a Docker account, and a GitHub account with Copilot A web browser
Before the lab About 15 minutes of prerequisites, at home: installing the tools and downloading the sandbox images Nothing
Where it runs MicroVMs on your machine, each with its own private Docker engine, and optionally in the cloud Entirely in your browser
Commands Real, in your own terminal Scripted: the same output for everyone
The agent The real GitHub Copilot, which uses your Copilot requests Scripted answers to the lab's prompts
Cost Your Copilot usage, plus pay-as-you-go compute if you take the optional cloud module None
Clean up The last module removes the sandboxes, secrets and MCP server the lab created Nothing to clean up
Best for Taking the lab for real, with a real agent on your own machine Previewing, revisiting or teaching the lab, or following it where you can't install tools
